text:
Ava (Marketing): Quick heads-up: draft for the product launch post is live in the doc: https://docs.google.com/example. Focus: Redwood Optimize, short benchmark blurb, and a tiny embeddings example + inbound lead routing. Need legal + sales review by EOD Wed so we can publish Thu morning.

Diego (Content): I'll paste the minimal curl embedding snippet to include inline. Keeping it copy/paste-ready.

Diego (Content): ```bash
# embeddings (curl)
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\\\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \\\\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\\\n  -d '{"model":"open-embedding-mini","input":"Summarize Redwood Optimize benefits"}'
```

Diego (Content): And a short JSON response example: ```json
{"embedding":[0.012,-0.034,0.087,...],"model":"open-embedding-mini","usage":{"input_tokens":6}}
```

Nina (Legal): Quick pass looks good. Two requests: 1) remove hard numeric claim like "5x cheaper" unless we can cite a benchmark; change to "dramatically lower per-token cost with batching and caching"; 2) reword any SLA statements to indicate "where contracted" so we don't imply hosted guarantees. Approve after edits.

Ava (Marketing): Will update copy now.

Sam (Sales): For CTAs: we need clear routing. Recommend: "Request a demo" -> HubSpot form hb-102 (enterprise AE queue); "Try Hosted API" -> /signup?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=optimize_launch (growth SDR); "See Optimize in action" -> webinar (Eventbrite + webhook into HubSpot list). Also flag webinar registrants as MQL if company_size > 50.

Ava (Marketing): Pasted CTA mapping into doc:
- Request a demo -> HubSpot form ID: hb-102 (AE: enterprise)
- Try Hosted API -> /signup?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=optimize_launch (assign: growth SDR flow)
- Webinar signup -> Eventbrite -> HubSpot list "Optimize Webinar" (tag: webinar_reg)

Sam (Sales): Add this ops note: if registrant.company_size > 50 AND role in ["Eng","Product","ML"], mark high-priority and create AE task.

Ava (Marketing): Added to ops playbook.

Diego (Content): I trimmed the benchmark claim and added a conservative caption: "Latency and per-token cost measured on supported model variants; results vary by workload." Keeping it cautious.

Nina (Legal): Fine, but drop the word "public" from the caption to avoid confusion.

Diego (Content): Done. Removed "public". Also inserted the embedding code block inline and shortened the example text.

OpsBot: Reminder: publishing job scheduled for 2024-08-15T09:00Z. Final copy lock: 2024-08-14T16:00Z. If edits after that, ping @ops.

Ava (Marketing): Great. Please drop a :thumbsup: here when you approve the final CMS copy. Nina/Sam?

Nina (Legal): :thumbsup: approved (CMS copy must match doc).

Sam (Sales): :thumbsup: approved. I'll send the HubSpot form mapping in a follow-up DM.

Ava (Marketing): Thanks all — I'll push to CMS and kick off the scheduled publish. Closing thread.
